tab.title: Prompt Library
tab.label: Prompt Library
tab.tooltip: Prompt Library · read-only prompt probe + local library

btn.quarantine: Save broken file and rebuild empty library

lbl.artistRequired: Artist string (required; it becomes the entry itself)
lbl.modelOptional: Model (optional: which model this string is for)

ph.title: Title for this prompt (required)
ph.artistString: Artist string, e.g. artist:xxx, artist:yyy, … (once saved, it is the entry itself)
ph.loraPrompt: A prompt that works with this LoRA; copy it with one click after saving

dlg.rebuildMsg: The current content will be saved as library.broken.<time>.json, then library.json is reset to an empty library. This needs your confirmation and cannot be undone.
dlg.deleteFavoriteMsg: “{title}” will be deleted; the store file is overwritten with a new version (the previous version stays in library.bak.json).
dlg.deleteArtistMsg: “{text}” will be deleted (the previous version stays in artists.bak.json).
dlg.deleteLoraMsg: The note for “{name}” will be deleted (the previous version stays in loras.bak.json).
dlg.pickHistory: Pick a reference image from history

empty.noMatch: No matching favorites (try another keyword or filter)
empty.noFavorites: No favorites yet. Pick a prompt on the Probe page and click “★ Favorite prompt”.
empty.artistsNone: No artist strings yet. Click “＋ Add artist string” above and paste one; you can optionally attach a reference image.
empty.lorasNone: No records yet. Click “＋ Add LoRA note” above, pick a LoRA and write down its prompt.
empty.noChain: No “sampler with a positive input → text encoder” structure found in this workflow. Make sure a workflow is actually open on the canvas.

notice.merged: (a newer version on disk was merged in)
notice.rebuilt: Empty library rebuilt; the original content was saved as {name}
notice.libraryEmpty: The library is empty (first run). The file is created after you save the first entry.
notice.exportUnsupported: Download is not supported in this environment
notice.noSelection: No prompt selected yet: click one on the Probe page (or “Select”), then click “★ Favorite prompt”.
notice.selectionEmpty: The selected entry is empty (usually a runtime-generated or unverified one), so it cannot be favorited. Pick another.

err.noApiLibrary: ComfyUI API unavailable: favorites are disabled (the read-only probe still works).
err.noApiArtists: ComfyUI API unavailable: artist strings are disabled.
err.noApiLoras: ComfyUI API unavailable: LoRA notes are disabled.
err.libraryCorrupt: The favorites file cannot be parsed; writing has stopped to protect your data: {error}
err.libraryDiskBad: The favorites file on disk is not valid JSON; writing stopped to avoid overwriting it. Use “Export raw content” or “Save broken file and rebuild empty library” in the panel first.
err.libraryBadJson: The favorites file is not valid JSON: {error}
err.artistsBadJson: The artist-string file is not valid JSON; writing has stopped to protect your data: {error}
err.artistsDiskBad: The artist-string file on disk is not valid JSON; writing stopped to avoid overwriting it
err.lorasBadJson: The LoRA note file is not valid JSON; writing has stopped to protect your data: {error}
err.lorasDiskBad: The LoRA note file on disk is not valid JSON; writing stopped to avoid overwriting it
err.fileTooLarge: File too large ({size}MB); the import limit is 10MB
err.importNotJson: Not a valid favorites export (JSON parse failed)
err.importNoItems: No importable entries (the structure must be {version, items:[...]})
err.readHistory: Failed to read the generation history: HTTP {status}
err.readModelList: Failed to read the model list: HTTP {status}
err.modelListShape: Unexpected model list format (not an array)
err.readImage: Failed to read the image: HTTP {status}
err.thumbLoad: Reference image failed to load (the file may have been cleaned up)
err.canvas: The browser could not produce a thumbnail copy (canvas encoding failed)
err.readWorkflow: Failed to read the workflow: HTTP {status}

warn.statusNotConfirmed: Parse status is “{status}”; until it is confirmed this may not be the final text
warn.staleWidget: The widget still holds old text that a link overrides (ignored)
warn.fromCandidate: This entry comes from “candidate text”: {reason}; parse status is “{status}”, so it is not necessarily the final prompt
warn.bypassed: ⚠ Not taking part in this run: {parts} (the text below is for reference only)

probe.candidatesCount: {n} text encoders are not referenced by any sampling chain
probe.candidatesHint: It cannot be confirmed whether these nodes take part in generation; they are shown as candidates only.

art.fallback: The original is no longer in output; showing the compressed copy
art.noModelHint: No model selected (click “Select model” to pick one from your model list)
art.pickHintPicked: Selected: {filename}{folder} — it will be compressed to about 1024px on save
art.pickHintKeep: Keeping the current reference image (unchanged on save)
art.loadedCount: {n} images loaded (click to select, click again to cancel)
art.noHistoryImages: No images found in the generation history
art.tempTitle: {filename}{folder} (temporary image: ComfyUI may clean it up; a copy was stored when saved)

why.enhancer: generated by a prompt-enhancer node at runtime
why.rewriter: generated by a prompt-rewriter node at runtime

core.candUnreferenced: This text encoder is not connected to any sampler positive input (not referenced by the current sampling chain)
core.chainNotTraced: Could not find a text encoder along {entry} (path: {hops})
core.guiderSingle: {cls} #{id} has a single conditioning input; it was treated as positive
core.runtimeGenerated: {cls} generates its text at runtime ({why}); it cannot be read statically
core.widgetMissing: {cls} widget “{field}” has no value (it may be renamed to an input or not initialized)
core.fieldNoValue: Field “{field}” has neither a link nor a readable widget value
core.nodeMissing: Node #{id} is not in the current graph
core.joinPartEmpty: Segment {k} has neither a link nor a widget value (treated as an empty string)
core.switchLinkMissing: switch comes from a link (source node #{id} does not exist)
core.switchRuntime: switch ← {cls} #{id} (decided at runtime; cannot be judged statically)
core.switchUndecided: The switch direction cannot be determined statically → no “final text” is given, only both branches for manual review
core.getNoSetNode: No Set node found for key “{key}” (existing keys: {keys})
core.setNodeNoValue: The paired Set node (#{id} {cls}) has neither a link nor a widget value
core.genericGuess: Node class {cls} is not registered in the adapter table; guessed from its only text widget “{field}” without character-by-character verification
core.genericUnregistered: Node class {cls} is not registered; the value was taken upstream through input “{field}” (status downgraded to candidate)
core.unregistered: Node class {cls} is not registered as a text source; its text cannot be determined
core.staleWidget: {length} chars of old text are still stored in this widget but overridden by a link (the parsed text above is the effective one)
core.wildcardBrace: Contains the wildcard {a|b}; the executed text may differ from what is shown
core.wildcardName: Contains the wildcard __name__; the executed text may differ from what is shown
core.wildcardWeight: Contains (word:weight) syntax, which is normal prompt weighting
